scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'cwd=$(pwd); app_root=${INIT_CWD:-$PWD}; case "$cwd" in */nodevenv/*/*/lib) base=${cwd%%/nodevenv/*}; app=${cwd#*/nodevenv/}; app=${app%%/*}; app_root="$base/$app";; esac; rm -rf "$app_root/.next"; echo "[deploy] Cleared stale .next build output at $app_root/.next"'
scripts.postinstall: sh -c 'cwd=$(pwd); app_root=${INIT_CWD:-$PWD}; case "$cwd" in */nodevenv/*/*/lib) base=${cwd%%/nodevenv/*}; app=${cwd#*/nodevenv/}; app=${app%%/*}; app_root="$base/$app";; esac; echo "[deploy] Building from $app_root with npx next build --webpack"; cd "$app_root" && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npx next build --webpack'
